verdict.rationale: incident.io's follow-ups docs say the product captures post-incident work and tracks it to completion (docs-80, docs-7). The integrations directory documents exporting follow-ups as GitHub or GitLab Issues with changes synced back, and syncing incident actions with Asana tickets (intdir-1, intdir-2, docs-74). Webhooks are also documented as a way to keep track of follow-ups externally (docs-33). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync, detailed documentation of sync direction and completion-status mapping, and evidence for other common trackers such as Jira or Linear.
